verb, third conjugation

Other words

  • sternō, sternere, strāvī, strātum — throw to the ground, knock down; tackle

    verb, third conjugation · also used · classical · Verg. A. 9.666 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 46, 47; Traupman 336

    Lewis & Short: “to throw to the ground, overthrow, prostrate (mostly poet.)”. Traupman also uses it for a tackle in American football.
